flavor.phonemic_palette: germanic (continental / Gothic register: thiudans/reiks, dithematic -s/-az names, retained th/w, ai/au diphthongs, heavy root-initial stress - the Iranian-Germanic Alan horse-aristocracy) / near_eastern (old_persian / axsatran: the -pura cities and dida-citadels, the satrapal Xshacapavan/Marzapana office-register, the paridaida garden-courts, the poet-king populace, vowel-rich Indo-Iranian phonology, the genitive '-ahya')

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Aryamark — domineering martial aristocracy of the synthesis; conquest, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Aryamark are a warlike martial aristocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Thiodons [Conquest Aristocracy (thiodons over aryastan)]. They prize conquest, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
